json_contract_checks.known_gap_disclosed: CLI-parse-time validation errors (product_cli.cpp's own argument checks, e.g. --kv-placement gpu without --gpu-layers) print plain text to stdout/stderr and do not respect --json -- this is pre-existing behavior from Phase 12H, unrelated to the RC2->RC3 delta, not a regression introduced this phase, and out of this release-readiness phase's own scope to fix (Section 1 of the Phase 27 task: no new product feature scope). Every runtime-level rejection (the compat_check.c architecture/shape gate, AUTO_FALLBACK_EXHAUSTED, model-load failure, etc.) DOES correctly emit a single clean JSON object via print_error_json() when --json is set -- confirmed directly this phase.

fail_closed_audit.note: all confirmed passing under ASan this phase (ctest_llama_asan_targeted above)

performance_claim_audit.note: Phase 25's own conclusion (docs/performance-optimization.md): no MEMBRANE-owned model-load/decode hot loop found. No 'faster'/'performance optimized'/'improved inference speed' claim appears in any release-facing doc for this cycle -- confirmed by direct grep across README.md, docs/release-v0.3.0-rc3.md, docs/compat-expansion.md, docs/compatibility.md, docs/performance-profiling.md, docs/performance-optimization.md.

external_validation_status.note: Backend diversity on one physical developer host is not host/user diversity -- see docs/release-v0.3.0-rc3.md's 'External validation status' section. Phase 28 handoff: validate on at least two additional independent physical hosts before considering a stable v0.3.0.

known_limitations: Vulkan validated on a small number of real local hosts/devices (NVIDIA GTX 1650 Mobile class, AMD Radeon RADV RENOIR integrated) -- not a general claim about other GPUs, vendors, or hosts.
CUDA is not a MEMBRANE product path -- evaluated in Phase 26 (docs/compat-expansion.md), deferred: no validation hardware available.
Qwen2 support is scoped to Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct specifically, not 'all Qwen2 models'.
VRAM/estimate accuracy depends on model, context size, and hardware -- never an absolute OOM guarantee.
Independent-host external validation remains pending (see external_validation_status above).
